profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Newfold Digital
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with 7+ years of experience building robust, scalable, and maintainable backend systems using C#, ASP.NET Core, Web API, SQL Server/MySQL etc.

Have designed RESTful APIs, implemented microservices architectures, and integrated a range of third-party services—including Unsplash, CTCT. I also bring hands-on experience incorporating AI-powered features like image captioning using OpenAI and other machine learning tools.

I’m passionate about clean code, performance optimization, and building software that solves real-world problems. I’ve worked in Agile teams, collaborated with frontend and DevOps counterparts, and contributed to cloud-native solutions using Azure and Docker.

🔧 Skills: .NET Core, C#, Web API, Azure, SQL Server, Entity Framework, Docker, OpenAI, Unsplash API, CTCT API, Git, CI/CD
